questions.question: What kind of relationship exists between income and demand in case of normal goods?

options.text: Sometimes there is a direct and sometimes an inverse relationship.
There is no impact of income on demand.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e., __There is a direct relationship__

__
 
• **There is a direct relationship**__ between income and demand in the case of normal goods.
 
• They are directly related to each other.
 
• If the income increases, the demand will also rise, and if the income decreases, demand will also fall.
 
• A normal good is that which experiences an increase in its demand because of the rise in the income of consumers.
 
• There is an exception in Giffen / Griffin Goods.

questions.question: Which economist developed international trade theory in 1817 based on comparative advantage and specialisation?
